parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left blade and handle assembly of the scissors, made of stainless steel, forming one half of the cutting mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one handle loop for gripping. It works together with the other blade handle set to perform cutting actions.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot relative to the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right blade and handle assembly of the scissors, made of stainless steel, forming the other half of the cutting mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the second cutting edge and handle loop, allowing the user to apply force to close the blades together for cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot relative to the left blade handle set.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: This is the central screw that connects the two blade handle sets, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the pivot point, allowing the two blades to rotate smoothly against each other while maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place, allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
